processes.Name: powershell.exe
processes.CommandLine:
"C:\WINDOWS\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -NoProfile -Command "try { [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch {}
$root='.tmp\active-cognitive-operation-schema-specialization-1'; $proc=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*Delta_Dev*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*active-cognitive*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*pytest*' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine; $current=$PID; $modelOrTest=$proc | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -ne $current -and ($_.Name -match 'python|pytest' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*llama*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*pytest*') }; @{processes=$proc; active_count=$proc.Count; active_model_or_pytest_count=$modelOrTest.Count; note='No active model or pytest child should remain; current audit command may appear in process list.'} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content \"$root\process_cleanup.json\" -Encoding UTF8; $modelOrTest | Format-List"

note: No active model or pytest child should remain; current audit command may appear in process list.
